errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите групи население, като възрастните спрямо младите хора, жените спрямо мъжете и българските граждани спрямо хората без българско гражданство. Вертикалната ос показва процента на всяка категория.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the axes. This is a horizontal bar chart, so the vertical axis contains the categories (the three comparison groups), and the horizontal axis represents the values (percentages). The description states the opposite.

errors.text_span: Тя е етикетирана с различни цветове, съответстващи на следните категории:
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis is labeled with colors. The legend, not the axis, maps colors to the different response categories.
The description incorrectly maps the category 'малко по-лесен' (a little easier) to the color 'светло синьо' (light blue). According to the legend, this category is represented by the color red.

The description incorrectly maps the category 'много по-труден' (much harder) to the color 'тъмно лилаво' (dark purple). According to the legend, this category is represented by the color light blue/teal.

The description fails to provide details about the value axis (the horizontal axis) as required by the prompt. It does not mention the units (percentage is assigned to the wrong axis), the value range (approximately 0 to 90), or the fact that the axis has no visible tick marks or labels because the values are annotated directly on the bars.
